events.text: City council formally seized all Roman Catholic art, forming part of the collection.

evidence.quote: all Roman Catholic art was formally seized by the city council in 1648

events.label: collection acquisition
events.text: Napoleon disbanded the guilds; their large paintings, including Hals works, joined the collection.

evidence.quote: the next large group of paintings to join
the collection occurred when Napoleon disbanded the guilds in the Netherlands in 1794

events.label: founding
events.text: Museum was established in the former Dominican church cloisters, Haarlem.

evidence.quote: The museum was founded in 1862 in the newly renovated former Dominican church cloisters

events.text: A work was sold from the municipal museum to a Brussels museum.

events.text: Museum took on the name of Frans Hals after moving to its present location.

events.text: Museum split into two locations; modern art moved to Museum De Hallen.

evidence.quote: In 1950 , the museum was split in two locations
